    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 0, 0))

    """Add a bevel modifier and apply it."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
    
    # Add bevel modifier
    mod = obj.modifiers.new(name="Bevel", type='BEVEL')
    mod.width = radius
    mod.segments = segments
    mod.limit_method = 'ANGLE' # or 'WEIGHT', 'WIDTH' depending on desired behavior. Angle is often safer for uniform bevels.
    mod.bevel_angle = math.radians(45) # Default angle
    
    # Apply modifier
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)

def orient_z_to_vector(obj, vector):

def main():
    # Block 0: Scene Reset & Units
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
    
    # Clear orphan data
    for mesh in bpy.data.meshes:
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)
    for mat in bpy.data.materials:
        bpy.data.materials.remove(mat)
        
    bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length = 1
    bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'

    # Block 1: Materials
    mat_bamboo = make_material("mat_bamboo", (0.85, 0.75, 0.50, 1.0))
    mat_leather = make_material("mat_leather", (0.40, 0.20, 0.10, 1.0))
    mat_metal = make_material("mat_metal", (0.70, 0.70, 0.70, 1.0))
    mat_wood = make_material("mat_wood", (0.60, 0.45, 0.30, 1.0))

    # Block 2: Geometry Generation
    
    # --- SECTION 1 – Create Base Bottom Panel ---
    base_bottom = add_cube("base_bottom", (0.4572, 0.3048, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Rotate so +Z aligns +Z (already default)
    # Anchor to world origin (already at 0,0,0)
    # Offset (0,0,0)
    apply_material(base_bottom, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 2 – Create Base Front Wall Panel ---
    base_front = add_cube("base_front", (0.4572, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align base_front.bottom_face to base_bottom.top_face
    # base_bottom top face is at Z = 0.015/2 = 0.0075
    # base_front bottom face is at Z = -0.015/2 = -0.0075
    # Delta Z = 0.0075 - (-0.0075) = 0.015
    base_front.location.z += 0.015
    # Offset (0, 0.1524, 0)
    base_front.location.y += 0.1524
    apply_material(base_front, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 3 – Create Base Back Wall Panel ---
    base_back = add_cube("base_back", (0.4572, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))

    base_back.location.z += 0.015
    # Offset (0, -0.1524, 0)
    base_back.location.y += -0.1524
    apply_material(base_back, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 4 – Create Base Left Wall Panel ---
    base_left = add_cube("base_left", (0.3048, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align base_left.bottom_face to base_bottom.top_face
    base_left.location.z += 0.015
    # Offset (-0.2286, 0, 0)
    base_left.location.x += -0.2286
    apply_material(base_left, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 5 – Create Base Right Wall Panel ---
    base_right = add_cube("base_right", (0.3048, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))

    base_right.location.z += 0.015
    # Offset (0.2286, 0, 0)
    base_right.location.x += 0.2286

    # --- SECTION 6 – Create Corner Protectors ---
    # Helper to create a corner protector at a specific corner
    def create_corner_protector(name, face_refs, offset):
        cp = add_cube(name, (0.02, 0.02, 0.02), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
        # Align center to Avg of faces
        avg_loc = align_center_to_avg_faces(face_refs)
        cp.location = avg_loc
        # Offset
        cp.location.x += offset[0]
        cp.location.y += offset[1]
        cp.location.z += offset[2]
        apply_material(cp, mat_metal)
        bevel_object(cp, 0.002, 4)
        return cp

    # Front-Left Corner: base_front.left_face, base_left.front_face, base_bottom.top_face

    cp_FL = create_corner_protector("corner_protector_FL", [
        (base_front, 'left'),
        (base_left, 'front'),
        (base_bottom, 'top')
    ], (0.01, 0.01, 0.01))

    # Front-Right Corner: base_front.right_face, base_right.front_face, base_bottom.top_face
    cp_FR = create_corner_protector("corner_protector_FR", [

        (base_bottom, 'top')

    lid_top = add_cube("lid_top", (0.4572, 0.3048, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align lid_top.bottom_face to base_back.top_face
    # base_back top face Z:
    # base_back was placed at Z=0.015 (bottom aligned to base_bottom top).
    # base_back height is 0.254. So top is at 0.015 + 0.254 = 0.269.
    # lid_top bottom is at -0.015/2 = -0.0075.
    # Delta Z = 0.269 - (-0.0075) = 0.2765
    lid_top.location.z += 0.2765
    # Offset (0, 0, 0.254)
    lid_top.location.z += 0.254
    apply_material(lid_top, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 8 – Create Lid Front Wall Panel ---
    lid_front = add_cube("lid_front", (0.4572, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align lid_front.bottom_face to lid_top.top_face
    # lid_top top face Z:
    # lid_top bottom was at 0.269. Height 0.015. Top is at 0.269 + 0.015 = 0.284.
    # lid_front bottom is at -0.0075.
    # Delta Z = 0.284 - (-0.0075) = 0.2915
    lid_front.location.z += 0.2915
    # Offset (0, 0.1524, 0)
    lid_front.location.y += 0.1524
    apply_material(lid_front, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 9 – Create Lid Back Wall Panel ---
    lid_back = add_cube("lid_back", (0.4572, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align lid_back.bottom_face to base_back.top_face
    # base_back top face Z is 0.269.
    # lid_back bottom is at -0.0075.
    # Delta Z = 0.269 - (-0.0075) = 0.2765
    lid_back.location.z += 0.2765
    # Offset (0, -0.1524, 0)
    lid_back.location.y += -0.1524
    apply_material(lid_back, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 10 – Create Lid Left Wall Panel ---
    lid_left = add_cube("lid_left", (0.3048, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align lid_left.bottom_face to lid_top.top_face
    # lid_top top face Z is 0.284.
    # lid_left bottom is at -0.0075.
    # Delta Z = 0.284 - (-0.0075) = 0.2915
    lid_left.location.z += 0.2915
    # Offset (-0.2286, 0, 0)
    lid_left.location.x += -0.2286
    apply_material(lid_left, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 11 – Create Lid Right Wall Panel ---
    lid_right = add_cube("lid_right", (0.3048, 0.254, 0.015), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align lid_right.bottom_face to lid_top.top_face
    # Delta Z = 0.2915
    lid_right.location.z += 0.2915
    # Offset (0.2286, 0, 0)
    lid_right.location.x += 0.2286
    apply_material(lid_right, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 12 – Create Left Hinge ---
    # Cylinder diameter 0.01 -> radius 0.005. Length 0.05.
    # Rotate so +Z aligns +Y.
    # Default cylinder is along Z. To align Z to Y, rotate -90 deg around X.
    hinge_L = add_cylinder("hinge_L", 0.005, 0.05, (0, 0, 0), (-math.radians(90), 0, 0))
    # Align hinge_L.center to Avg(base_back.left_face, lid_back.left_face)
    avg_loc = align_center_to_avg_faces([
        (base_back, 'left'),
        (lid_back, 'left')
    ])
    hinge_L.location = avg_loc
    # Offset (0.1, 0, 0)
    hinge_L.location.x += 0.1
    apply_material(hinge_L, mat_metal)

    # --- SECTION 13 – Create Right Hinge ---
    hinge_R = add_cylinder("hinge_R", 0.005, 0.05, (0, 0, 0), (-math.radians(90), 0, 0))
    # Align hinge_R.center to Avg(base_back.right_face, lid_back.right_face)
    avg_loc = align_center_to_avg_faces([
        (base_back, 'right'),
        (lid_back, 'right')

    hinge_R.location = avg_loc

    hinge_R.location.x += -0.1

    # --- SECTION 14 – Create Handle Bar ---
    handle_bar = add_cube("handle_bar", (0.3048, 0.02, 0.02), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))

    avg_loc = align_center_to_avg_faces([

    compartments = add_cube("compartments", (0.40, 0.25, 0.05), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))

    compartments.location = (0, 0, 0)

    # --- SECTION 18 – Create Cutlery Tray ---
    cutlery_tray = add_cube("cutlery_tray", (0.20, 0.10, 0.02), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align cutlery_tray.center to base_bottom.center
    cutlery_tray.location = (0, 0, 0)
    # Offset (0.1, 0, 0.025)
    cutlery_tray.location.x += 0.1
    cutlery_tray.location.z += 0.025
    apply_material(cutlery_tray, mat_wood)

    # --- SECTION 19 – Create Left Strap ---
    strap_L = add_cube("strap_L", (0.30, 0.02, 0.005), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))
    # Align strap_L.center to Avg(base_left.top_face, lid_left.bottom_face)
    avg_loc = align_center_to_avg_faces([
        (base_left, 'top'),
        (lid_left, 'bottom')
    ])
    strap_L.location = avg_loc
    # Offset (0.1, 0, 0.127)
    strap_L.location.x += 0.1
    strap_L.location.z += 0.127

    strap_R = add_cube("strap_R", (0.30, 0.02, 0.005), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))

    avg_loc = align_center_to_avg_faces([

    buckle_L = add_cube("buckle_L", (0.03, 0.03, 0.01), (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0))

    buckle_R.location.x += -0.1
